name: repo
description: Issues, work items and pull requests on GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Bitbucket and Jira through one runner — the platform's CLI when it's installed, its REST API otherwise — with tokens from pass, never shown, and every change asked first

guardUx.title: Explain this guard's decisions
guardUx.description: When the guard denies or asks, say why in plain words and what to do instead (the guard still decides; this changes only the words)

guardLog.title: Keep a log of this guard's decisions
guardLog.description: Remember the last 200 denies and asks (the entry and the command's verb only, never the command or the reason) for the project plugin's /guards (the guard still decides)

ciBand.title: CI watch band
ciBand.description: After a git push, a band above the prompt with the state of that commit's CI runs (GitHub, through reporun, read only) and a toast when one fails

ciBandPollSeconds.title: CI band first poll (seconds)
ciBandPollSeconds.description: Seconds before the second read of the runs; it then doubles twice (30, 60, 120 by default)

ciBandMinutes.title: CI band stops after (minutes)
ciBandMinutes.description: The band stops reading the runs after this long

ciBandUsePass.title: CI band may use the token in pass
ciBandUsePass.description: When the platform token is in pass, reporun decrypts it for each read, which may raise a pinentry prompt; off, the band runs only with the CLI's own sign-in

bandCap.title: Most bands above the prompt
bandCap.description: At most this many bands draw above the prompt, chosen by priority (1 to 5); the rest are listed by /bands. A band that holds something is never hidden
